# Prompts

The rules a role runs by, rendered from one template per kind of role in `prompts/meta/`, and the Harvest Protocol. `hub prompts render <template> --vars <json|file>` prints a role's rules; the MCP server serves the same render as a prompt with the variables as arguments. The format, and how to change a rule: [prompts/meta/README.md](../../prompts/meta/README.md). Walk-through: [5. Roles](../start/5-roles.md#rules-rendered-per-role).

## Templates

| Template | For | Fragments it includes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [head](../../prompts/meta/head.md) | a project's head: dispatches to workers, accepts by artifact, keeps the track card | [turn](../../prompts/meta/fragments/turn.md), [head-cycle](../../prompts/meta/fragments/head-cycle.md), [boundaries](../../prompts/meta/fragments/boundaries.md), [preempt](../../prompts/meta/fragments/preempt.md), [privacy](../../prompts/meta/fragments/privacy.md), [report](../../prompts/meta/fragments/report.md), [reflect](../../prompts/meta/fragments/reflect.md) |
| [orchestrator](../../prompts/meta/orchestrator.md) | the orchestrator over the heads: places work, reviews, reflects over the fleet | [turn](../../prompts/meta/fragments/turn.md), [boundaries](../../prompts/meta/fragments/boundaries.md), [preempt](../../prompts/meta/fragments/preempt.md), [privacy](../../prompts/meta/fragments/privacy.md), [report](../../prompts/meta/fragments/report.md), [orch-reflect](../../prompts/meta/fragments/orch-reflect.md), [reflect](../../prompts/meta/fragments/reflect.md) |
| [worker](../../prompts/meta/worker.md) | a worker: takes one dispatch per turn, reports, never hands out work | [turn](../../prompts/meta/fragments/turn.md), [boundaries](../../prompts/meta/fragments/boundaries.md), [preempt](../../prompts/meta/fragments/preempt.md), [privacy](../../prompts/meta/fragments/privacy.md), [report](../../prompts/meta/fragments/report.md), [reflect](../../prompts/meta/fragments/reflect.md) |

## Variables

Every variable a template declares is required: a missing or blank one is refused, naming it, and the render writes nothing (`hub prompts render` exits 2). A variable a template does not declare is ignored, so one set renders every template.

| Variable | head | orchestrator | worker | What the role reads there |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `role` | yes | yes | yes | its own name, the one it reports under |
| `kind` | yes | yes | yes | its kind, as the registry has it |
| `project` | yes | yes | yes | the project it works on |
| `cwd` | yes | yes | yes | its working directory |
| `head` | yes | yes | yes | whom it answers to: a worker's head, a head's orchestrator; for the orchestrator, where escalations leave the fleet (the owner) |
| `allowed_paths` | yes | yes | yes | the paths it may write to, a markdown list indented by two spaces (it sits inside a list item) |
| `track_goal` | yes | yes | yes | the goal of its track |
| `track_facts` | yes | yes | yes | the track's facts, markdown, headings at level 3 or below |
| `owner_decisions` | yes | yes | yes | the owner's decisions so far, a markdown list |
| `base_ref` | yes | yes | yes | the ref its diffs are taken against, e.g. `origin/main` |
| `private_patterns` | yes | yes | yes | what must never reach public git, described: the patterns `private_check` looks for |
| `private_check` | yes | yes | yes | the command it runs before handing a branch over (for review, as a bundle or a patch): it checks the commit messages and the lines the diff against `base_ref` adds, and prints nothing when they are clean |
| `plan_file` | yes |  |  | heads: where new tasks are cut from |
| `verdict_cmd` | yes |  |  | heads: the command that records an acceptance verdict |

## Harvest

Harvest this dialog into the hub — projects, tasks, decisions, links, open questions (the Harvest Protocol). No need to fetch HARVEST.md. `hub harvest` prints it; [HARVEST.md](../../HARVEST.md) is the same text.
